71679209.name: Chromyl fluoride
71679209.description: Chromyl fluoride is an inorganic compound with the formula CrO2F2. It is a violet-red colored crystalline solid that melts to an orange-red liquid.

73776233.name: Romaciclib
73776233.description: Romaciclib is an investigational new drug being evaluated by Ryvu Therapeutics for the treatment of acute myeloid leukaemia . It is a dual inhibitor of CDK8 and CDK19.

74405225.name: 5-MeO-MPT
74405225.description: 5-MeO-MPT, also known as 5-methoxy-N-methyl-N-propyltryptamine, is a chemical compound of the tryptamine and 5-methoxytryptamine families.

76286825.name: Dapolsertib
76286825.description: Dapolsertib is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated for the treatment of cancer.

90015465.name: Neluxicapone
90015465.description: Neluxicapone (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name) is a catechol O-methyltransferase inhibitor which has not been marketed as of 2024.

101089385.name: Boron triazide
101089385.description: Boron triazide, also known as triazidoborane, is a thermally unstable compound of boron and nitrogen with a nitrogen content of 92.1% .

101943145.name: Curium(III) fluoride
101943145.description: Curium fluoride or curium trifluoride is the chemical compound composed of curium and fluorine with the formula CmF3.

102239721.name: Succinprotocetraric acid
102239721.description: Succinprotocetraric acid is an organic chemical compound with the formula C22H18O12.

121269225.name: Lazertinib
121269225.description: Lazertinib, sold under the brand names Lazcluze and Leclaza among others, is an anti-cancer medication used for the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer.

123132009.name: Adamantyl-THPINACA
123132009.description: Adamantyl-THPINACA is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid, which was first reported to Europol in Slovenia in January 2015.

135398633.name: Guanosine triphosphate
135398633.description: Guanosine-5'-triphosphate is a purine nucleoside triphosphate.

135565033.name: Seclidemstat
135565033.description: Seclidemstat is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated for the treatment of cancer. It is a small-molecule inhibitor of lysine-specific demethylase 1 .

136126569.name: Farinamycin
136126569.description: Farinamycin is a quinazoline metabolite that has been isolated from Streptomyces griseus.

137359209.name: Ninerafaxstat
137359209.description: Ninerafaxstat is a cardiac mitotrope agent investigated by Imbria for diabetic cardiomyopathy, myocardial ischemia, and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.

139318505.name: Irafamdastat

154130665.name: Polonium dibromide
154130665.description: Polonium dibromide (also known as polonium bromide) is a chemical compound with the formula PoBr2.

165363817.name: 1-α-O-Galloylpunicalagin
165363817.description: 1-α-O-Galloylpunicalagin is an ester of gallic acid and punicalagin, a type of ellagitannin.

166560233.name: Zidesamtinib
166560233.description: Zidesamtinib, sold under the brand name Jideytro, is an anti-cancer medication used for the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer.

168947049.name: 5-MeO-MsBT
168947049.description: 5-MeO-MsBT, also known as 5-methoxy-N-methyl-N-sec-butyltryptamine, is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine and 5-methoxytryptamine families.

177586793.name: Molybdenum diphosphide
177586793.description: Molybdenum diphosphide is a binary inorganic compound of molybdenum metal and phosphorus with the chemical formula MoP2.

177841641.name: Molybdenum diarsenide
177841641.description: Molybdenum diarsenide is an arsenide of molybdenum, with the chemical formula MoAs2. Other arsenides of molybdenum are Mo2As3 and Mo5As4.

177924585.name: AB-5'F-BUTINACA
177924585.description: AB-5'F-BUTINACA is a synthetic cannabinoid of the indazole family.

177962217.name: HBL20016
177962217.description: HBL20016, also known as 5-methylthio-6-fluoro-N,N-dimethyltryptamine , is a non-selective serotonin receptor agonist and serotonergic psychedelic of the tryptamine family related to 5-MeO-DMT.

900000105.name: Actoxumab
900000105.description: Actoxumab is a human monoclonal antibody designed for the prevention of recurrence of Clostridioides difficile infection.

900000361.name: CT-5126
900000361.description: CT-5126, also known as 5-methoxy-6,8-dichloro-3-aminochroman, is a cyclized phenethylamine and 3-aminochroman derivative related to psychedelic phenethylamines like mescaline.

900000489.name: Cobatoxin
900000489.description: Cobatoxin is a toxin present in the venom of the scorpion Centruroides noxius. It blocks two potassium channel subtypes; voltage-gated and calcium-activated channels.

900000617.name: Dinosterane
900000617.description: Dinosterane is a steroidal alkane, also known as 4α,23,24-trimethylcholestane.

900001001.name: Indacaterol/glycopyrronium bromide/mometasone
900001001.description: Indacaterol/glycopyrronium bromide/mometasone, sold under the brand name Enerzair Breezhaler among others, is an inhalable fixed-dose combination medication for the treatment of asthma.

900001129.name: Lenzilumab
900001129.description: Lenzilumab is a humanized monoclonal antibody that targets colony stimulating factor 2 /granulocyte-macrophage colony stimulating factor .

900001257.name: Metanx
900001257.description: Metanx is a prescription medical food made by Alfasigma that contains L-methylfolate (as Metafolin, a calcium salt of vitamin B9), methylcobalamin and pyridoxal 5'-phosphate .

900001513.name: Pemtumomab
900001513.description: Pemtumomab is a mouse monoclonal antibody used to treat cancer.

900001641.name: Polyethylene naphthalate
900001641.description: Polyethylene naphthalate (poly or PEN) is a polyester derived from naphthalene-2,6-dicarboxylic acid and ethylene glycol. As such it is related to poly , but with superior barrier properties.

900001897.name: Sodium fluoride/malic acid
900001897.description: Sodium fluoride/malic acid is a type of mouthwash consisting of the teeth-strengthening sodium fluoride and the saliva stimulant malic acid. It is used in xerostomia.

900002025.name: Tetranitratoborate
900002025.description: Tetranitratoborate is an anion composed of boron with four nitrate groups.
